findings.summary_md: SonicWall PSIRT published advisory SNWLID-2026-0014 covering CVE-2026-19868, an authentication enforcement flaw in the SonicOS SSLVPN service that lets a user with valid credentials for an alternate authentication method bypass SAML controls, including SAML-enforced MFA. The CVE record marks discovery as external and lists Gen7 and Gen8 SonicOS builds 7.3.3-7015 and older and 8.2.2-8015 and older as affected. The record carries CWE-308 with a CVSS 3.1 base score of 7.5.
findings.title: SonicWall PSIRT advisory SNWLID-2026-0014 for CVE-2026-19868

findings.summary_md: NIST NVD published its entry for CVE-2026-19868 on November 6, 2026, sourcing SonicWall, with the description of an SSLVPN authentication enforcement flaw allowing bypass of SAML authentication controls and SAML-enforced MFA. The entry references the SonicWall PSIRT advisory and the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. Both the NVD entry and the underlying CVE record were last modified later the same day.
findings.title: NVD entry for CVE-2026-19868
